panels.title: nodes up
panels.description: Nodes whose /metrics answered the last scrape.

panels.title: nodes down
panels.description: Nodes whose /metrics did not answer the last scrape: daemon stopped, node down or listener unreachable.

panels.title: restarts
panels.description: Daemon restarts over the dashboard time range, from the process start time.

panels.title: api requests/s
panels.description: Requests served by the daemon listeners, all nodes and routes taken together. Includes the Prometheus scrapes.

panels.title: api 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of the requests answered with a 5xx code. Red above 1%.

panels.title: api p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of the requests were served faster than this, all nodes and routes taken together.

panels.title: collector errors/s
panels.description: Calls to oc3 answered with a code other than 2xx, or never answered (code=error).

panels.title: collector backlog
panels.description: Items the nodes hold for oc3, all feeds taken together. It drains when oc3 accepts them.

panels.title: requests by code
panels.description: Requests served, by http status code.

panels.title: 4xx and 5xx by node
panels.description: Refused (4xx) and failed (5xx) requests. 401 and 403 are clients with a bad or expired token.

panels.title: latency by node
panels.description: p95: 95% of the requests were faster. avg: the mean. A p95 far above the avg means a few slow routes: see api routes.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (method, url) (rate(opensvc_api_route_requests_total{job="om3_api", instance=~"$instance", url=~"$route", url!~"/metrics.*"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: top routes by requests
panels.description: The 15 busiest routes, from /metrics/api. The scrapes are left out.

targets.expr: topk(15, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, url) (rate(opensvc_api_route_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="om3_api", instance=~"$instance", url=~"$route", url!~"/metrics.*"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: top routes by p95 latency
panels.description: The 15 slowest routes at the 95th percentile, from /metrics/api. A route with few requests can rank high on a single slow one.

targets.expr: sum by (method, url, code) (rate(opensvc_api_route_requests_total{code=~"[45]..", job="om3_api", instance=~"$instance", url=~"$route", url!~"/metrics.*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: route errors
panels.description: Routes answering 4xx or 5xx, from /metrics/api. Empty when no request failed.

panels.title: rate limited requests
panels.description: Requests refused by the listener rate limiter, by route, from /metrics/api, and the limiter own errors. Empty until a request is refused.

panels.title: collector calls by feed and code
panels.description: Calls to oc3 by feed. 2xx: accepted. Other codes: refused by oc3. error: no answer (oc3 or network down).

panels.title: collector backlog by node and feed
panels.description: Items the node holds for oc3, by feed. A steady rise means oc3 is not keeping up or not reachable.

panels.title: actions not acknowledged by oc3
panels.description: Local actions whose begin or end oc3 did not acknowledge yet. They stay on disk until it does.

panels.title: publications
panels.description: published: messages put on the daemon internal bus. pushed: copies delivered to subscribers. pushed over published is the average fan-out.

panels.title: slow subscribers
panels.description: Subscription queues filling up, by subscriber family. debug: the queue grew, still under half its size. info: past half. warn: past three fourths. full: the queue reached its size, and the daemon panics if it stays full past a grace time. A family that keeps showing up does not keep up.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (opensvc_pubsub_subscription_total{operation="create", job="om3", instance=~"$instance"}) - (sum by (instance) (opensvc_pubsub_subscription_total{operation="delete", job="om3", instance=~"$instance"}) or sum by (instance) (opensvc_pubsub_subscription_total{operation="create", job="om3", instance=~"$instance"}) * 0)

panels.title: open subscriptions
panels.description:
Created minus deleted subscriptions. A steady rise is a leak.
filter keys: distinct keys messages were published to, which grows with the number of objects.

panels.title: top events by kind
panels.description: The 15 most published event kinds, from /metrics/pubsub.

panels.title: critical events
panels.description: Event kinds worth a look, from /metrics/pubsub: DaemonStatusUpdated, Error, ForgetPeer, NodeStale, SubscriptionQueueThreshold. Only the intervals where some were published show.

panels.title: runs by action
panels.description: Scheduled runs, by action, all objects taken together.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (path, action) (increase(opensvc_scheduler_object_runs_total{job="om3_scheduler", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: top objects by runs
panels.description: The 15 objects with the most scheduled runs, from /metrics/scheduler.

panels.title: host and opensvc cpu
panels.description: The cpus the node and the opensvc slice use, in cores, from /metrics/pg. cpus: the online cpus of the node, and the ones opensvc.slice may run on.

panels.title: host and opensvc memory
panels.description: The memory the node uses (MemTotal minus MemAvailable) and its total, and the memory of the opensvc slice, from /metrics/pg.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6 / sum by (instance) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="host"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6

sum by (instance) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"}) / sum by (instance) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="host"})

sum by (instance) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6 / sum by (instance) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_cpus{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"})

panels.title: opensvc share of the host
panels.description: The share of the cpu and of the memory the node uses that the opensvc slice uses, and the share of the cpus opensvc.slice may run on that it uses. The rest runs out of opensvc: the other slices, the kernel.

panels.title: cpu by slice
panels.description: The cpu used by each top level slice, in cores: opensvc.slice, and the others, as system.slice, user.slice, machine.slice, where the guests libvirt or podman start may land.

panels.title: memory by slice
panels.description: The memory used by each top level slice.

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="host"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="host"}[$__rate_interval]))

label_replace(sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="opensvc"}[$__rate_interval])), "path", "opensvc.slice", "path", "")

sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="slice"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="slice"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: io by slice
panels.description: The bytes read and written by each top level slice, and by the node, summed over the block devices no other device is stacked on.

panels.title: tasks by slice
panels.description: The tasks of the node, and of each top level slice.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, namespace) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="namespace", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6 or sum by (instance, namespace) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", namespace="root", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6

panels.title: cpu by namespace
panels.description: The cpu used by each namespace slice, in cores. The root namespace has no slice, its objects being in opensvc.slice: it is the sum of its objects.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, namespace) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="namespace", namespace=~"$namespace"}) or sum by (instance, namespace) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", namespace="root", namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: memory by namespace
panels.description: The memory used by each namespace slice, the root namespace being the sum of its objects.

targets.expr: sum by (instance, namespace) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="namespace", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="namespace", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval])) or sum by (instance, namespace) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", namespace="root", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", namespace="root", namespace=~"$namespace"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: io by namespace
panels.description: The bytes read and written by each namespace slice, the root namespace being the sum of its objects.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_usage_usec{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6)

panels.title: top objects by cpu
panels.description: The 10 objects using the most CPU, in cores, from their cgroup at /metrics/pg.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object"}))

panels.title: top objects by memory
panels.description: The 10 objects using the most memory, from their cgroup at /metrics/pg.

targets.expr: topk(10, opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_current_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object"} / (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_max_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object"} != +Inf))

panels.title: top objects by memory over limit
panels.description: Memory used over the cgroup memory limit, for the objects that have one, from /metrics/pg. max: the highest ratio on the node. Close to 100% the object processes get reclaimed or killed.

panels.title: objects without cgroup
panels.description: Objects the daemon found no cgroup for, so they have no CPU or memory data at /metrics/pg.

panels.title: heartbeat receive operations
panels.description: Data received from the peers over the heartbeats. patch: changes applied. full: a whole copy, after a peer restart or a missed patch. ping: nothing changed. A rise of full means peers keep resending all their data.

panels.title: dns requests
panels.description: Requests to the cluster DNS backend.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_stat_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object", stat=~"file_dirty|file_writeback"}))

panels.title: top objects by unwritten data
panels.description: Data the object wrote that is not on disk yet (dirty and writeback page cache), from /metrics/pg. Steadily high: the object writes faster than its disks take it.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_stat_pages{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object", stat="pgmajfault"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: top objects by major page faults
panels.description: Pages the object had to read back from disk, per second, from /metrics/pg. High: its memory is too small for what it works on, or it was swapped out. Empty when no object faults.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_cpu_stat{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object", stat="throttled_usec"}[$__rate_interval])) / 1e6 > 0)

panels.title: top objects by cpu throttling
panels.description: Time per second the object processes were held back by the cgroup cpu quota, from /metrics/pg. Shown: the object wants more cpu than its quota. Empty when no object is throttled.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_memory_stat_pages{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$object", scope="object", stat="pgscan_direct"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: top objects by direct memory reclaim
panels.description: Pages scanned per second by the object processes themselves to free memory, from /metrics/pg. Each scan stalls the process: the object is short of memory, against its limit or the node. Empty when no object reclaims.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_read_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", path=~"$object"}[$__rate_interval]) + rate(opensvc_pg_cgroup_io_write_bytes{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", path=~"$object"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: top objects by io
panels.description: The 10 objects reading and writing the most bytes, from their cgroup io.stat.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (instance, path) (opensvc_pg_cgroup_tasks{job="om3_pg", instance=~"$instance", scope="object", path=~"$object"}))

panels.title: top objects by tasks
panels.description: The 10 objects running the most tasks, from their cgroup pids.current.

panels.title: cpu
panels.description: CPU used by the daemon, in cores.

panels.title: resident memory
panels.description: Memory the daemon process holds in RAM.

panels.title: go heap in use
panels.description: Memory the Go heap uses. A steady rise across GCs is a leak.

panels.title: goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines running in the daemon. A steady rise is a leak.

panels.title: open fds over limit
panels.description: Open file descriptors over the process limit.

panels.title: gc pause max
panels.description: The longest Go garbage collection pause.
